{"tools":[
{"name":"list_staff","description":"Lists staff members, optionally filtered by role, location or employment status. Use it to look up who works in the shop or to find a staff ID.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"role":{"type":"string","description":"Job role, e.g. cashier, stockroom, supervisor"},"location":{"type":"string","description":"Store or site name"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["active","on_leave","terminated"]},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":200,"default":50}},"required":[]},"request":"Show me all active cashiers at the High Street store."},
{"name":"get_staff_member","description":"Retrieves the full profile of one staff member: contact details, contract type, role, start date and emergency contact. Use it when you need the details of a specific employee.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"staff_id":{"type":"string","description":"Unique staff ID"}},"required":["staff_id"]},"request":"Pull up the contract type and emergency contact for staff member S-1042."},
{"name":"create_shift","description":"Creates a new shift on the rota and assigns it to a staff member. Use it when adding a shift for a particular person, date and time range.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"start_time":{"type":"string","description":"HH:MM 24h"},"end_time":{"type":"string","description":"HH:MM 24h"},"location":{"type":"string"},"role":{"type":"string"},"break_minutes":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"default":30},"notes":{"type":"string"}},"required":["staff_id","date","start_time","end_time"]},"request":"Put Maria on a 9am to 5pm shift at the till this Saturday with a 45 minute break."},
{"name":"update_shift","description":"Changes the time, location, role or assignee of an existing shift. Use it to adjust a shift that is already on the rota.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"shift_id":{"type":"string"},"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"start_time":{"type":"string"},"end_time":{"type":"string"},"location":{"type":"string"},"role":{"type":"string"},"notes":{"type":"string"}},"required":["shift_id"]},"request":"Move shift SH-8841 so it starts at 10:00 instead of 08:00."},
{"name":"cancel_shift","description":"Cancels a scheduled shift and optionally notifies the assigned employee. Use it when a shift is no longer needed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"shift_id":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"},"notify_staff":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["shift_id"]},"request":"Cancel shift SH-9020 because we're closing early for stocktake, and let the employee know."},
{"name":"get_rota","description":"Returns the rota (all shifts) for a given date range and location, grouped by day and employee. Use it to see who is working when.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"location":{"type":"string"},"staff_id":{"type":"string","description":"Restrict to one employee"}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]},"request":"What does the rota look like for next week at the Riverside shop?"},
{"name":"publish_rota","description":"Publishes a draft rota for a week so staff can see it and receive notifications. Use it once the schedule is finalised.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"week_start":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"Monday of the week"},"location":{"type":"string"},"send_notifications":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["week_start","location"]},"request":"The rota for the week starting 3 March is done, publish it to the team at Riverside."},
{"name":"find_available_staff","description":"Finds staff who are free and not on leave during a given time window, optionally filtered by role or training. Use it when you need cover.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"start_time":{"type":"string"},"end_time":{"type":"string"},"role":{"type":"string"},"required_training":{"type":"string","description":"Course name, e.g. 'Food Safety L2'"},"max_weekly_hours_remaining":{"type":"number"}},"required":["date","start_time","end_time"]},"request":"Who's free to cover a 2pm to 10pm shift this Friday and has the age-restricted sales training?"},
{"name":"swap_shifts","description":"Swaps two scheduled shifts between two employees after checking for conflicts and hour limits. Use it when staff agree to trade shifts.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"shift_id_a":{"type":"string"},"shift_id_b":{"type":"string"},"approved_by":{"type":"string","description":"Manager staff ID"}},"required":["shift_id_a","shift_id_b"]},"request":"Tom and Aisha want to trade their shifts, swap SH-7710 with SH-7755."},
{"name":"request_time_off","description":"Submits a holiday, sick or other leave request for an employee for a date range. Use it to record leave on someone's behalf.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"leave_type":{"type":"string","enum":["annual","sick","unpaid","parental","compassionate","other"]},"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"half_day":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"comment":{"type":"string"}},"required":["staff_id","leave_type","start_date","end_date"]},"request":"Log annual leave for Priya from 14 to 18 April."},
{"name":"list_time_off_requests","description":"Lists leave requests filtered by status, employee or date range. Use it to review what is pending or who is away.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","enum":["pending","approved","denied","cancelled"]},"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"from_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"to_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":[]},"request":"Which holiday requests are still waiting for my approval?"},
{"name":"decide_time_off_request","description":"Approves or denies a pending leave request and records an optional reason. Use it to action a specific request.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"request_id":{"type":"string"},"decision":{"type":"string","enum":["approve","deny"]},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["request_id","decision"]},"request":"Deny leave request TO-3321 because we're already short-staffed that week."},
{"name":"get_leave_balance","description":"Returns an employee's remaining annual leave entitlement, leave taken and accrued days for the current leave year. Use it before approving holidays.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"as_of_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["staff_id"]},"request":"How many holiday days does Jamal have left this year?"},
{"name":"get_timesheet","description":"Returns hours actually worked (clock-in/out records, overtime, breaks) for an employee or location over a period. Use it to check attendance and hours.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"location":{"type":"string"},"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"include_overtime_breakdown":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]},"request":"How many hours did Lena actually work last week, including overtime?"},
{"name":"calculate_payroll","description":"Calculates gross wages for a pay period from timesheets, rates and adjustments, producing a per-employee payroll summary without submitting it. Use it to preview wage costs before paying.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"period_start":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"period_end":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"location":{"type":"string"},"staff_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"include_employer_costs":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":["period_start","period_end"]},"request":"Run the payroll report for 1 to 28 February so I can see what we owe in wages."},
{"name":"update_hourly_rate","description":"Sets a new hourly pay rate for an employee effective from a given date and records the reason. Use it for raises or rate corrections.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"new_rate":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"currency":{"type":"string","default":"GBP"},"effective_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["staff_id","new_rate","effective_date"]},"request":"Give Carlos a raise to £13.50 an hour starting next month."},
{"name":"refund_wage_deduction","description":"Refunds or reverses a previously applied deduction on an employee's pay (e.g. a wrongly charged uniform or till shortage) in the next payroll run. Use it to correct deductions, not customer refunds.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"deduction_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"description":"Partial amount; omit to refund in full"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["deduction_id","reason"]},"request":"The £25 till shortage deduction DED-554 on Nina's pay was a mistake, refund it in full."},
{"name":"assign_training_course","description":"Assigns a training course to one or more employees with a due date. Use it to enrol staff in required or optional training.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"course_id":{"type":"string"},"staff_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1},"due_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"mandatory":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["course_id","staff_ids"]},"request":"Enrol the three new starters, S-1101, S-1102 and S-1103, in the fire safety course, due by the end of the month."},
{"name":"record_training_completion","description":"Records that an employee completed a training course, with completion date, score and certificate reference. Use it after training is finished.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"staff_id":{"type":"string"},"course_id":{"type":"string"},"completed_on":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"score":{"type":"number"},"certificate_ref":{"type":"string"},"expires_on":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["staff_id","course_id","completed_on"]},"request":"Mark Omar as having passed manual handling training today with a score of 92."},
{"name":"get_training_compliance_report","description":"Reports which employees have overdue, expiring or missing mandatory training, filterable by course or location. Use it to check compliance before audits.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"location":{"type":"string"},"course_id":{"type":"string"},"expiring_within_days":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"default":30},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["overdue","expiring","missing","all"],"default":"all"}},"required":[]},"request":"Give me a report of everyone whose food hygiene certificate expires in the next 60 days."}
]}
